test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting on a wall in a straight row, and all of them are facing north. R is on the immediate right of S. Q is at one of the extreme end and has T as his immediate neighbour. V is the immediate neighbour of T and U. S is sitting third from the extreme right end. Which of the following pairs is sitting at each of the extreme end ?
solution:
**P, Q, R, S, T, U and V** are sitting on a wall in a straight row, and all of them are facing north. 

1. Q is at one of the extreme end and has T as his immediate neighbour.

2. V is the immediate neighbour of T and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27d500c643b619e66e4fa8b151d125d2a30168d95ac2c1e1b6af90923518f6f8.png] 

3. S is sitting third from the extreme right end.

The above condition cannot be satisfied in Case I, so it is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66575a61c6133aaa66ea135c5c0ebb0f7774af1df41645c94df6dd1d90736990.png] 

4. R is on the immediate right of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ad8cdf0cc29d386aacc018d57ec08dbb76bf432a19d2fce02af5bcd7b247a20.png] 

P, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86461f19d8c292490cacff21094e586d4c0096609b6a0cfd8c376285b68c0fcc.png] 

Clearly, PQ is sitting at each of the extreme end.

Hence, ‘**PQ**’ is the correct answer.
